quote: I don't have any money right now, so I'll be back in about six months.
stewart_read: Classic 'I can't afford it' trigger with a canonical flip available ('what you can't afford is your current bill') and the rep instead explained the no-upfront-cost feature.
alternative_hypothesis: Rep may have judged a hard flip too aggressive this early and chose to build rapport first — but nothing in the next 40 seconds shows a deliberate delayed-flip strategy, just drift into features.
coaching_implication: Use the bill-swap explanation as the vehicle for the flip, not a standalone feature pitch: tie 'no money right now' directly to 'that's exactly why the current bill is the problem.'

quote: I don't have time right now.
stewart_read: Second deferral of the same flavor as 00:15; rep does not acknowledge it at all and the transcript moves straight into scheduling talk.
alternative_hypothesis: This could be a diarization misattribution given the surrounding fragmented lines, but even so the rep's next line does not address time constraints directly, so the miss stands either way.
coaching_implication: Name the objection explicitly ('I hear you, this'll take five minutes') rather than letting it dissolve into a scheduling pivot.

quote: Yeah. So it's more of a monthly thing. So it's kind of all wrapped up into that monthly cost.
stewart_read: Financing-mechanism explanation is closer-tier content; the rep should redirect to the specialist rather than attempt to explain the payment structure.
coaching_implication: Use the escape hatch: 'That's exactly what our specialist walks through with real numbers — let's get that on the calendar.'

quote: Because this has been hot all winter. This is ridiculous.
stewart_read: Unsolicited bill-pain complaint right as she pulls up the actual bill — the single best emotional anchor in the call, and it passes without the rep reflecting it back.
coaching_implication: Should have been flipped immediately: 'That's exactly the kind of bill we replace — let's lock in Saturday so you can see the number.'

quote: Alright. So text me, and then I will text you back this copy this picture of this,
stewart_read: Bill photo capture deferred to text after the call rather than completed live — consistent with verified events showing bill_collection resulted in 'deferred'.
coaching_implication: Fine as a fallback, but rep should confirm the photo actually gets sent before hanging up, not just assume it will.

quote: Yeah. But you have a cheaper bill. How much are you normally paying right now?
stewart_read: Bill amount captured cleanly and quickly, but the number ($100-150/month) is never referenced again after this line — captured and dropped.
coaching_implication: Should have circled back to the $150 figure when setting the appointment: 'we'll show you what replaces that $150.'
